notes: Factual filename expectations from SimpleEpisodeTests, EpisodeNumberTests, EpisodeNumberWithoutSeasonTests, AbsoluteEpisodeNumberTests and MultiEpisodeTests. Relative paths use a synthetic show directory. Null season and ending episode become zero; these cases exercise declared series libraries. EpisodePathParserTest directory inputs use an equivalent .mkv file; Windows separators become forward slashes because scanning uses host-native paths. Null ends and an end equal to the start both mean a single episode. Series title comparisons normalize release separators while retaining abbreviation and acronym dots.
